pages.title: Deep Sea Ripple
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable to: §r Boots$(br2)§lEffect: §r Hold Shift underwater and scroll the mouse wheel to adjust swim speed up to a high multiple.$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, Librarian trades, loot chests.$(br)Conflicts with Wind Ripple, Depth Strider and other movement enchantments.
